verdict.rationale: Canny documents centralizing feedback captured automatically from Gong, Intercom, Slack, support, sales and review platforms, plus directly from customers on its Portal. That covers the single-repository and colleague/customer intake parts of the story. Querying the repository is only shown through the MCP integration (asking an LLM what customers requested); no native search or filter feature is documented. missing for 10: documented native search/filtering across the repository, explicit internal-colleague submission flow, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can access one searchable repository for all product requests and feedback from colleagues and customers

citations.quote: Automatically capture feedback from Gong, Intercom, Slack, and dozens of other sources, or directly from customers on your Portal.
Autopilot captures feedback from support, sales, and review platforms automatically.
Ask your LLM what customers asked for and understand the context behind each request.
